investigatedNonFindings.summary: An early version of the emission-cap ghost accountant fired at depth >=100 with minted == cap + 1 wei (e.g. 37703166833685587120599957 > 37703166833685587120599956).
investigatedNonFindings.rootCause: Harness false positive, NOT a contract over-mint. A directed replay of the failing sequence showed the CONTRACT under-mints by exactly 1 wei vs the mathematically exact perSecond*elapsed bound (5242345897006866983073289817 minted vs 5242345897006866983073289818 true cap). The +1 came from floor recombination at rate-change / stake boundaries: floor((a+b)*k/N) >= floor(a*k/N)+floor(b*k/N), so the contract's coarse per-fold accumulation can release ~1 wei the harness's naive window-sum dropped.
investigatedNonFindings.resolution: Added a bounded round-DOWN dust allowance of ~2 wei per emitting window (verified ~1e18x smaller than a single window's emission, so a genuine double-mint/retro-accrue still trips the invariant). Confirmed clean across 11 seeds at 500x120.
investigatedNonFindings.conclusion: Confirms the story-009 emission-cap / no-retro-accrue property holds; the contract rounds DOWN exactly as documented.

conclusion: CONFIRMATION. The story-009 pool lifecycle state machine (PoolState enum + finalizeAndReset) preserves all four targeted properties under 60,000-call stateful fuzz campaigns across 11 seeds: states stay legal and match the driven transitions; finalizeAndReset is gated on a fully-drained pool and leaves a clean Active pool with zeroed (R,P) and lastRewardTime==now; total reward emission never exceeds perSecond*activeSeconds across full Active->Migrating->reset->Active cycles (no double-mint or retro-accrue, only documented round-down dust); and idle-hold principal is conserved and fully backed throughout. No counterexamples; zero candidate findings.
